strings.costerror: The enrolment fee must be a number.
strings.defaultrole_desc: Select the role to assign to users after making a payment.
strings.enrolenddate_help: If enabled, users can be enrolled until this date only.
strings.enrolenddaterror: The enrolment end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
strings.enrolperiod_desc: Default length of time that the enrolment is valid. If set to zero, the enrolment duration will be unlimited by default.
strings.enrolperiod_help: Length of time that the enrolment is valid, starting with the moment the user is enrolled. If disabled, the enrolment duration will be unlimited.
strings.enrolstartdate_help: If enabled, users can only be enrolled from this date onwards.
strings.expiredaction_help: Select the action to be performed when a user's enrolment expires. Please note that some user data and settings are deleted when a user is unenrolled.

strings.instancedescription_help: The description is only shown on the 'Enrolment methods' page and is not shown to users enrolling in the course.
strings.nocost: There is no cost to enrol in this course!
strings.paymentaccount_help: Enrolment fees will be paid to this account.
strings.pluginname_desc: The enrolment on payment enrolment method allows you to set up courses requiring a payment. If the fee for any course is set to zero, then students are not asked to pay for entry. There is a site-wide fee that you set here as a default for the whole site and then a course setting that you can set for each course individually. The course fee overrides the site fee.
strings.privacy:metadata: The enrolment on payment enrolment plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.status_desc: Allow users to make a payment to enrol into a course by default.
